# Data

```{r}
# adding data set
data <- read.csv("data.csv")

data$sex <- as.factor(data$sex)
data$ethnicity <- as.factor(data$ethnicity)
data$year <- as.factor(data$year)


#rename satisfactions
data <- dplyr::rename(
  data,
  `Security`   = AR_1_1,
  `Acceptance` = AR_1_2,
  `Initiative` = AR_1_3,
  `Competence` = AR_1_4,
  `Meaning`    = AR_1_5)


```

# LPA

### Models

```{r}


data%>% 
  dplyr::select(Security, Acceptance, Initiative, Competence, Meaning) %>%
  single_imputation() %>%
  estimate_profiles(n_profiles=1:2,  
                    variances = "varying",
                    covariances = "varying") ->model6_all

model6_all



data%>%  dplyr::select(Security, Acceptance, Initiative, Competence, Meaning) %>%
  single_imputation() %>%
  estimate_profiles(n_profiles=1:3, 
                    variances = "varying",
                    covariances = "zero") ->model2_all

model2_all


data%>% dplyr::select(Security, Acceptance, Initiative, Competence, Meaning) %>%
  single_imputation() %>%
  estimate_profiles(n_profiles=1:6,  
                    variances = "equal",
                    covariances = "zero") ->model1_all

model1_all



```

### Plot

```{r}

############################################################

tidyLPA::plot_profiles(
  model2_2,
  rawdata = FALSE,  # Hide individual participants' observations.
  add_line = TRUE, # Connect each profile's indicator means.
  sd = FALSE       # Hide standard-deviation bars.
) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    # Rotate and align indicator labels to improve readability.
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 35, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)
  )
```

#### Comparing classes in Model 2

```{r}
#Model 2 -- 2,3
#############################################################
#Analysing if different classes (solutions) have significant differences
##############################################################

m2c2 <- model2_all$model_2_class_2$model  # Solution with 2 classes; model 2
m2c3 <- model2_all$model_2_class_3$model  # Solution with 3 classes; model 2


compare_lmr <- function(smaller, larger) {
  tidyLPA::calc_lrt(
    n = smaller$n,
    null_ll = smaller$loglik,
    null_param = smaller$df,
    null_classes = smaller$G,
    alt_ll = larger$loglik,
    alt_param = larger$df,
    
    alt_classes = larger$G
  )
}


compare_lmr(m2c2, m2c3)

data$class2 <- as.factor( model2_all$model_2_class_2$model$classification)

data$class3 <- as.factor( model2_all$model_2_class_3$model$classification)


# Count participants assigned to each class in each solution.
table(data$class2)
table(data$class3)


```

#### Comparing Variables Across the Groups

```{r}

################################################################
#Do the following analysis on the class
################################################################

data$latent_groups <- as.factor(
  model2_3$model_2_class_3$model$classification)

table(data$latent_groups)


#########################################################
# comparing the variables in the final LPA across the groups
#########################################################

data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Security, Acceptance, Initiative, Competence, Meaning,      
    latent_groups) %>%                       
  gtsummary::tbl_summary(
    
    by = latent_groups,                      
    
    type = list(  
      c(Security, Acceptance, Initiative, Competence, Meaning) ~ "continuous"), 

    statistic = gtsummary::all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
    
    digits = gtsummary::all_continuous() ~ 2,  
    
    missing = "no"
  ) %>% gtsummary::modify_header(label = "**Comparison Across Three Classes**")

```

#### Prediction

```{r}


lm1 <- lm(AR_2 ~ latent_groups, data = data)

anova(lm1)


emmeans::emmeans(lm1, pairwise ~ latent_groups,
  adjust = "tukey")  


emmeans::eff_size(emmeans::emmeans(lm1, ~ latent_groups),
  edf = df.residual(lm1), sigma = sigma(lm1)

)



lm2 <- lm(AR_3 ~ latent_groups, data = data)

anova(lm2)


emmeans::emmeans(lm2, pairwise ~ latent_groups,
                 adjust = "tukey")  


emmeans::eff_size(
  emmeans::emmeans(lm2, ~ latent_groups),
  edf = df.residual(lm2),
  sigma = sigma(lm2)
)


```
